name: Thermocouple
summary: A thermocouple produces a temperature-dependent voltage associated with its dissimilar-metal junction system.
description: A thermocouple produces a temperature-dependent voltage associated with its dissimilar-metal junction system. Correct type, polarity and extension wiring matter when connecting it to an instrument.
readingNotes: Trace the thermocouple terminals and specified extension cable together.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A thermocouple generates a voltage signal; an RTD changes resistance.
